mil5.1.7:1.2: Pañc' eva dāni Ānanda vassasatāni saddhammo ṭhassatīti.
mil5.1.7:1.3: Puna ca parinibbānasamaye Subhaddena paribbājakena pañhaṃ puṭṭhena Bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.1.7:1.4: Ime ca Subhadda bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ, asuñño loko arahantehi assāti; asesavacanam-etaṃ, nissesavacanam-etaṃ, nippariyāyavacanam-etaṃ.
mil5.1.7:1.6: Pañc' eva dāni Ānanda vassasatāni saddhammo ṭhassatīti, tena hi: asuñño loko arahantehi assāti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.1.7:1.8: asuñño loko arahantehi assāti, tena hi: Pañc' eva dāni Ānanda vassasatāni saddhammo ṭhassaṭīti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.1.7:1.9: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho, gahanato pi gahanataro,balavato pi balavataro, gaṇṭhito pi gaṇṭhitaro, so tavānuppatto, tattha te ñāṇabalavipphāraṃ dassehi, makaro viya sāgarabbhantaragato ti.
mil5.1.7:2.1: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā: Pañc' eva dāni Ānanda vassasatāni saddhammo ṭhassatīti.
mil5.1.7:2.3: Ime ca Subhadda bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ, asuñño loko arahantehi assāti.
mil5.1.7:2.4: Tañ-ca pana mahārāja Bhagavato vacanaṃ nānatthañ-c' eva hoti nānābyañjanañ-ca. Ayaṃ sāsanaparicchedo, ayaṃ paṭipattiparidīpanā ti dūraṃ vivajjitā te ubho aññamaññaṃ.
mil5.1.7:2.5: Yathā mahārāja nabhaṃ paṭhavito dūraṃ vivajjitaṃ, nirayaṃ saggato dūraṃ vivajjitaṃ, kusalaṃ akusalato dūraṃ vivajjitaṃ, sukhaṃ dukkhato dūraṃ vivajjitaṃ,
mil5.1.7:2.6: evam-eva kho mahārāja te ubho aññamaññaṃ dūraṃ vivajjitā.
mil5.1.7:3.1: Api ca mahārāja, mā te pucchā moghā assa, rasato te saṃsandetvā kathayissāmi. Pañc' eva dāni Ānanda vassasatāni saddhammo ṭhassatīti yaṃ Bhagavā āha, taṃ khayaṃ paridīpayanto sesakaṃ paricchindi: vassasahassaṃ Ānanda saddhammo tiṭṭheyya sace bhikkhuniyo na pabbajeyyuṃ,
mil5.1.7:3.2: pañc' eva dāni Ānanda vassasatāni saddhammo ṭhassatīti.
mil5.1.7:3.3: Api nu kho mahārāja Bhagavā evaṃ vadanto saddhammassa antaradhānaṃ vā vadeti abhisamayaṃ vā paṭikkosatīti.-
mil5.1.7:3.5: Naṭṭhaṃ mahārāja parikittayanto sesakaṃ paridīpayanto paricchindi.
mil5.1.7:3.6: Yathā mahārāja puriso naṭṭhāyiko sabbasesakaṃ gahetvā janassa paridīpeyya: ettakaṃ me bhaṇḍaṃ naṭṭhaṃ, idaṃ sesakan-ti,
mil5.1.7:3.7: evam-eva kho mahārāja Bhagavā naṭṭhaṃ paridīpayanto sesakaṃ devamanussānaṃ kathesi: Pañc' eva dāni Ānanda vassasatāni saddhammo ṭhassatīti.
mil5.1.7:3.9: Pañc' eva dāni Ānanda vassasatāni saddhammo ṭhassatīti, sāsanaparicchedo eso;
mil5.1.7:4.1: yaṃ pana parinibbānasamaye Subhaddassa paribbājakassa samaṇe parikittayanto āha:
mil5.1.7:4.2: Ime ca Subhadda bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ, asuñño loko arahantehi assāti, paṭipattiparidīpanā esā. Tvaṃ pana taṃ paricchedañ-ca paridīpanañ-ca ekarasaṃ karosi.
mil5.1.7:4.3: Yadi pana te chando ekarasaṃ katvā kathayissāmi, sādhukaṃ suṇohi manasikarohi avimanamānaso.
mil5.1.7:5.1: Idha mahārāja taḷāko bhaveyya navasalilasampuṇṇo samukham-uttariyamāno paricchinno parivaṭumakato, apariyādiṇṇe yeva tasmiṃ taḷāke udakūpari mahāmegho aparāparaṃ anuppabandhanto abhivasseyya, api nu kho mahārāja tasmiṃ taḷāke udakaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyyāti. -
mil5.1.7:5.5: Evam-eva kho mahārāja Jinasāsanavarasaddhamma-taḷāko ācārasīlaguṇavattapaṭipatti-vimalanavasalilasampuṇṇo uttariyamāno bhavaggam-abhibhavitvā ṭhito.
mil5.1.7:5.6: Yadi tattha Buddhaputtā ācārasīlaguṇavattapaṭipatti-meghavassaṃ aparāparaṃ anuppabandhāpeyyuṃ abhivassāpeyyuṃ,
mil5.1.7:5.7: evam-idaṃ Jinasāsanavara-saddhammataḷāko ciraṃ dīgham-addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, arahantehi ca loko asuñño bhaveyya. Imam-atthaṃ Bhagavatā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ: Ime ca Subhadda bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ, asuñño loko arahantehi assāti.
mil5.1.7:6.1: Idha pana mahārāja mahatimahāaggikkhandhe jalamāne aparāparaṃ sukkha-tiṇa-kaṭṭha-gomayāni upasaṃhareyyuṃ, api nu kho so mahārāja aggikkhandho nibbāyeyyāti. -
mil5.1.7:6.2: Na hi bhante, bhiyyo bhiyyo so aggikkhandho jaleyya, bhiyyo bhiyyo pabhāseyyāti. -
mil5.1.7:6.3: Evam-eva kho mahārāja dasasahassimhi lokadhātuyā Jinasāsanavaraṃ ācārasīlaguṇavattapaṭipattiyā jalati pabhāsati.
mil5.1.7:6.4: Yadi pana mahārāja taduttariṃ Buddhaputtā pañcahi padhāniyangehi samannāgatā satatam-appamattā padaheyyuṃ, tīsu sikkhāsu chandajātā sikkheyyuṃ, cārittañ-ca vārittañ-ca sīlaṃ samattaṃ paripūreyyuṃ, evam-idaṃ Jinasāsanavaraṃ bhiyyo bhiyyo ciraṃ dīgham-addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, asuñño loko arahantehi assāti imam-atthaṃ Bhagavatā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ: Ime ca Subhadda bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ, asuñño loko arahantehi assāti.
mil5.1.7:7.1: Idha pana mahārāja siniddha-sama-sumajjita-sappabhāsa-vimalādāsaṃ saṇhasukhuma-gerukacuṇṇena aparāparaṃ majjeyyuṃ, api nu kho mahārāja tasmiṃ ādāse mala-kaddama-rajojallaṃ jāyeyyāti. -
mil5.1.7:7.2: Na hi bhante, aññadatthu vimalataraṃ yeva bhaveyyāti.-Evam-
mil5.1.7:7.3: eva kho mahārāja Jinasāsanavaraṃ pakatinimmalaṃ byapagata-kilesamalarajojallaṃ; yadi taṃ Buddhaputtā ācārasīla-guṇa-vattapaṭipatti-sallekhadhutaguṇena Jinasāsanavaraṃ sallikheyyuṃ, evam-idaṃ Jinasāsanavaraṃ ciraṃ dīgham-addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya asuñño ca loko arahantehi assāti imam-atthaṃ Bhagavatā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ: Ime ca Subhadda bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ, asuñño loko arahantehi assāti.
mil5.1.7:7.4: Paṭipattimūlakaṃ mahārāja Satthusāsanaṃ paṭipattisārakaṃ, paṭipattiyā anantarahitāya tiṭṭhatīti.
mil5.1.7:8.1: Bhante Nāgasena, saddhammantaradhānan-ti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ saddhammantaradhānan-ti. -
mil5.1.7:8.4: adhigamantaradhānaṃ, paṭipattantaradhānaṃ, lingantaradhānaṃ. Adhigame mahārāja antarahite suppaṭipannassāpi dhammābhisamayo na hoti, paṭipattiyā antarahitāya sikkhāpadapaññatti antaradhāyati, lingaṃ yeva tiṭṭhati, linge antarahite paveṇupacchedo hoti. Imāni kho mahārāja tīṇi antaradhānānīti. -
mil5.1.7:9.1: Suviññāpito bhante Nāgasena pañho gambhīro uttānīkato, gaṇṭhi bhinno, naṭṭhā parappavādā bhaggā nippabhā katā, tvaṃ gaṇivaravasabhamāsajjāti.
